need from front to back through one convenient platform.

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

healthy.

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# Next-Generation Vector Vaccines for Swine Health

[Learn More][25]
[Contact Us][26]

## Our Mission

GeminiVax Kft is a Hungarian vaccine-development start-up focused on next-generation veterinary
vaccines for swine health.


Our mission is to reduce losses caused by major viral infections, improve piglet survival and
growth, and support sustainable productivity in modern swine production.


We are developing broad-spectrum veterinary vaccine candidates designed for a changing viral
landscape, where pathogen diversity, strain drift and regional variation increasingly challenge
conventional vaccine approaches.

[Explore][27]
[ChatGPT Image Jul 3, 2026, 12_30_00 PM.webp]

## What we do

GeminiVax develops broadly protective swine vaccine candidates using an advanced attenuated
influenza-virus vector platform originally developed by Capricorn Technologies GmbH.


The platform is designed to deliver carefully selected pathogen-derived immune targets, including
conserved cytotoxic T-cell epitopes and neutralising B-cell epitopes. This allows the development of
compact antigenic cassettes intended to stimulate both cellular and humoral immune responses.


Our strategy is to create vaccines that are less vulnerable to viral mutation, regional strain
variation and changing epidemiological patterns — particularly for respiratory and systemically
transmitted viral diseases of swine.

## Why It Matters

Swine viral diseases remain a major cause of mortality, reduced weight gain, reproductive losses,
secondary infections and increased production costs worldwide. Existing vaccines can be highly
valuable, but many are challenged by viral diversity, strain drift, incomplete cross-protection and
regional epidemiological differences.


GeminiVax is developing vaccine candidates designed to address these limitations through conserved
immune targets, vector-based antigen delivery and rational immune-response design.

## Core Innovative Technologies

##### Vector Platform

GeminiVax applies a double-attenuated influenza-virus vector that can be configured to carry
selected immune targets from pathogens of interest. The vector is intended to support strong
cellular immunity, mucosal responses and flexible antigen-cassette design.

##### Informatics-Guided Epitope Selection

Unique bioinformatics approach for in-silico selection of CTL and B-cell epitopes, prediction of
their relative immunogenic strength, and assembling into pathogen-originated epitope cassettes.

##### Built-In Immune Modulation

Selected immune-response modulators and synthetic adjuvant technologies may be incorporated to
enhance or shape vaccine-induced responses, including dendritic-cell activation and polarisation.

## In Development*

[Swine Flu Virus]

###### SIV Vaccine

A broadly protective vaccine candidate targeting major swine influenza subtypes, including H1N1,
H1N2 and H3N2, across regionally distinct North American, European and Asian lineages.

[Read More][28]
[PRRSV]

###### PRRSV Vaccine

A next-generation vaccine candidate targeting PRRSV-1 and PRRSV-2 across European, North American
and Asian lineages, with focus on conserved targets in variable and emerging variants.

[Read More][29]
[PCV-2]

###### PCV-2 Vaccine

A broadly protective PCV-2 vaccine candidate targeting major circulating genotypes, including PCV2a,
PCV2b and PCV2d, with extended coverage against globally emerging viral variants.

[Read More][30]
[CSFV]

###### CSF Vaccine

A vaccine candidate combining protective immune responses with marker/DIVA potential to support
disease control, surveillance and differentiation of infected from vaccinated animals.

[Read More][31]

GeminiVax is developing vaccine candidates designed to address these limitations through conserved
immune targets, vector-based antigen delivery and rational immune-response design.

## Core Innovative Technologies

##### Vector Platform

GeminiVax applies a double-attenuated influenza-virus vector that can be configured to carry
selected immune targets from pathogens of interest. The vector is intended to support strong
cellular immunity, mucosal responses and flexible antigen-cassette design.

##### Informatics-Guided Epitope Selection

Unique bioinformatics approach for in-silico selection of CTL and B-cell epitopes, prediction of
their relative immunogenic strength, and assembling into pathogen-originated epitope cassettes.

##### Built-In Immune Modulation

Selected immune-response modulators and synthetic adjuvant technologies may be incorporated to
enhance or shape vaccine-induced responses, including dendritic-cell activation and polarisation.

## In Development*

[Swine Flu Virus]

###### SIV Vaccine

A broadly protective vaccine candidate targeting major swine influenza subtypes, including H1N1,
H1N2 and H3N2, across regionally distinct North American, European and Asian lineages.

[Read More][28]
[PRRSV]

###### PRRSV Vaccine

A next-generation vaccine candidate targeting PRRSV-1 and PRRSV-2 across European, North American
and Asian lineages, with focus on conserved targets in variable and emerging variants.

[Read More][29]
[PCV-2]

###### PCV-2 Vaccine

A broadly protective PCV-2 vaccine candidate targeting major circulating genotypes, including PCV2a,
PCV2b and PCV2d, with extended coverage against globally emerging viral variants.

[Read More][30]
[CSFV]

###### CSF Vaccine

A vaccine candidate combining protective immune responses with marker/DIVA potential to support
disease control, surveillance and differentiation of infected from vaccinated animals.

[Read More][31]

* GeminiVax vaccine candidates are under development and are not yet registered veterinary products.

## For Partners and Investors

GeminiVax is building a focused portfolio of next-generation swine vaccine candidates targeting
major viral diseases of global economic importance.


The company is seeking strategic partnerships with animal-health companies, swine producers,
research institutions, grant organisations and investors interested in innovative vaccine
technologies for veterinary use.


Our development model is milestone-based, with vaccine candidates progressing from rational antigen
design and vector construction to immunological evaluation, target-animal testing, field studies and
licensing or co-development opportunities.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even
  further.

## Relentlessly Pursuing a More Equitable World for Every Child

UNICEF has helped save and meaningfully improve more children’s lives than any other humanitarian
organization. UNICEF won’t stop until every child is [healthy][114], [educated][115],
[protected][116] and [respected][117].

[A 5-year-old boy receives the polio vaccine from Shumaila, a UNICEF-supported polio vaccinator in
Lahore, Pakistan on January 11, 2021. ]

## Healthy

UNICEF workers brave war zones, treacherous terrain, disasters and disease to save lives and make
the world safe for kids.
[Read more][118]
[ A UNICEF-supported teacher and one of her students stand in front of the chalkboard at a school in
Mali.]

## Educated

UNICEF helps children continue their education through community-based schools, learning support and
other programs.
[Read more][119]
[Children staning in front of a UNICEF tent]

## Protected

UNICEF collaborates with families, partners and governments to ensure children can flourish free
from exploitation and abuse.
[Read more][120]
[Bharti Raju, 5, poses for photograph outside her house at Shirasgaon Mandap village in Jalna,
Maharashtra on Sunday, 19, Oct. 2020.]

## Respected

UNICEF knows children have the most at stake — and works to safeguard their rights and to ensure
their voices are heard.
[Read more][121]
[Lawrene O'Donnell and UNICEF USA's KIND Fund gives Malawi kids desks]

## Kids in Need of Desks

Join MS NOW’s Lawrence O’Donnell and help change a child's life with a simple desk.
[Help Kids Learn][122]
[Baby boy smiling at the camera while being held]

## Monthly Giving

Make a difference for children every day, all year! Monthly support allows UNICEF to be there
whenever needed.
[Donate][123]
[Smiling girls jumping rope]

## Play Can't Wait

UNICEF delivers play — like soccer balls, jump ropes and safe spaces to use them — as essential aid.
Because it is.
[Learn More][124]

## Always There for Children in Crisis

Other organizations help children, but [UNICEF does more][125] by [fighting for children’s
rights][126] and delivering the essentials every child needs for an equitable chance in life.

[Einkorn: The Oldest Ancient Grain Rapidly Gaining Attention from Researchers for Superior Gut
Health][24]
Einkorn is the oldest of the "ancient grains," and its rising popularity in recent years has led to
some interesting findings about this ancient grain, and just how healthy it is. Fortunately, recent
research has looked beyond the modern dogma which claims that the "gluten" found in wheat varieties
is toxic to human health, focusing instead on how wheat is grown and processed, since the gluten
from grains has been a part of the diet of humans for many thousands of years and was always
considered healthy. We have published much of this research ourselves in recent years. More recent
studies, many of them done in Turkey where einkorn (known as Siyez in Turkey) is native, and not an
introduced crop (like in the U.S.), have shown that einkorn is unique in producing lactic acid
bacteria and other "probiotics" necessary for gut health. This is accomplished by using traditional
"sourdough" preparations of the flour. In one study done in Turkey, they added einkorn flour to
"Peksimet", a traditional Turkish twice-baked bread valued for its hard, dry texture, long shelf
life, and role as a durable staple food in Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot cuisine. They found that the
einkorn flour resulted in a significant decrease in the glycemic index, which is important for those
suffering from diabetes or high blood sugar due to the consumption of too many carbohydrates.

[Einkorn: The Oldest Ancient Grain Rapidly Gaining Attention from Researchers for Superior Gut
Health][24]
Einkorn is the oldest of the "ancient grains," and its rising popularity in recent years has led to
some interesting findings about this ancient grain, and just how healthy it is. Fortunately, recent
research has looked beyond the modern dogma which claims that the "gluten" found in wheat varieties
is toxic to human health, focusing instead on how wheat is grown and processed, since the gluten
from grains has been a part of the diet of humans for many thousands of years and was always
considered healthy. We have published much of this research ourselves in recent years. More recent
studies, many of them done in Turkey where einkorn (known as Siyez in Turkey) is native, and not an
introduced crop (like in the U.S.), have shown that einkorn is unique in producing lactic acid
bacteria and other "probiotics" necessary for gut health. This is accomplished by using traditional
"sourdough" preparations of the flour. In one study done in Turkey, they added einkorn flour to
"Peksimet", a traditional Turkish twice-baked bread valued for its hard, dry texture, long shelf
life, and role as a durable staple food in Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot cuisine. They found that the
einkorn flour resulted in a significant decrease in the glycemic index, which is important for those
suffering from diabetes or high blood sugar due to the consumption of too many carbohydrates.

## [Einkorn: The Oldest Ancient Grain Rapidly Gaining Attention from Researchers for Superior Gut
## Health][39]

Einkorn is the oldest of the “ancient grains,” and its rising popularity in recent years has led to
some interesting findings about this ancient grain, and just how healthy it is.

Fortunately, recent research has looked beyond the modern dogma which claims that the “gluten” found
in wheat varieties is toxic to human health, focusing instead on how wheat is grown and processed,
since the gluten from grains has been a part of the diet of humans for many thousands of years and
was always considered healthy.

We have published much of this research ourselves in recent years.

More recent studies, many of them done in Turkey where einkorn (known as Siyez in Turkey) is native,
and not an introduced crop (like in the U.S.), have shown that einkorn is unique in producing lactic
acid bacteria and other “probiotics” necessary for gut health.

This is accomplished by using traditional “sourdough” preparations of the flour.

In one study done in Turkey, they added einkorn flour to “Peksimet”, a traditional Turkish
twice-baked bread valued for its hard, dry texture, long shelf life, and role as a durable staple
food in Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot cuisine.

They found that the einkorn flour resulted in a significant decrease in the glycemic index, which is
important for those suffering from diabetes or high blood sugar due to the consumption of too many
carbohydrates.

to rapidly advance a broad range of vaccine candidates into and through the clinic, including
candidates against Lyme disease, Shigella and Zika.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

# Next-Generation Vector Vaccines for Swine Health

[Learn More][25]
[Contact Us][26]

## Our Mission

GeminiVax Kft is a Hungarian vaccine-development start-up focused on next-generation veterinary
vaccines for swine health.


Our mission is to reduce losses caused by major viral infections, improve piglet survival and
growth, and support sustainable productivity in modern swine production.


We are developing broad-spectrum veterinary vaccine candidates designed for a changing viral
landscape, where pathogen diversity, strain drift and regional variation increasingly challenge
conventional vaccine approaches.

[Explore][27]
[ChatGPT Image Jul 3, 2026, 12_30_00 PM.webp]

## What we do

GeminiVax develops broadly protective swine vaccine candidates using an advanced attenuated
influenza-virus vector platform originally developed by Capricorn Technologies GmbH.


The platform is designed to deliver carefully selected pathogen-derived immune targets, including
conserved cytotoxic T-cell epitopes and neutralising B-cell epitopes. This allows the development of
compact antigenic cassettes intended to stimulate both cellular and humoral immune responses.


Our strategy is to create vaccines that are less vulnerable to viral mutation, regional strain
variation and changing epidemiological patterns — particularly for respiratory and systemically
transmitted viral diseases of swine.

## Why It Matters

Swine viral diseases remain a major cause of mortality, reduced weight gain, reproductive losses,
secondary infections and increased production costs worldwide. Existing vaccines can be highly
valuable, but many are challenged by viral diversity, strain drift, incomplete cross-protection and
regional epidemiological differences.


GeminiVax is developing vaccine candidates designed to address these limitations through conserved
immune targets, vector-based antigen delivery and rational immune-response design.

## Core Innovative Technologies

##### Vector Platform

GeminiVax applies a double-attenuated influenza-virus vector that can be configured to carry
selected immune targets from pathogens of interest. The vector is intended to support strong
cellular immunity, mucosal responses and flexible antigen-cassette design.

##### Informatics-Guided Epitope Selection

Unique bioinformatics approach for in-silico selection of CTL and B-cell epitopes, prediction of
their relative immunogenic strength, and assembling into pathogen-originated epitope cassettes.

##### Built-In Immune Modulation

Selected immune-response modulators and synthetic adjuvant technologies may be incorporated to
enhance or shape vaccine-induced responses, including dendritic-cell activation and polarisation.

## In Development*

[Swine Flu Virus]

###### SIV Vaccine

A broadly protective vaccine candidate targeting major swine influenza subtypes, including H1N1,
H1N2 and H3N2, across regionally distinct North American, European and Asian lineages.

[Read More][28]
[PRRSV]

###### PRRSV Vaccine

A next-generation vaccine candidate targeting PRRSV-1 and PRRSV-2 across European, North American
and Asian lineages, with focus on conserved targets in variable and emerging variants.

[Read More][29]
[PCV-2]

###### PCV-2 Vaccine

A broadly protective PCV-2 vaccine candidate targeting major circulating genotypes, including PCV2a,
PCV2b and PCV2d, with extended coverage against globally emerging viral variants.

[Read More][30]
[CSFV]

###### CSF Vaccine

A vaccine candidate combining protective immune responses with marker/DIVA potential to support
disease control, surveillance and differentiation of infected from vaccinated animals.

[Read More][31]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even
  further.

## The Pulitzer Center champions the power of stories to make complex issues relevant and inspire
## action.

### JOURNALISM

Through grant and fellowship programs, we provide financial and editorial support, training, and
collaboration networks for journalists to pursue in-depth, high-impact reporting projects.


Journalism

Global stories, local impact

Opportunities for Journalists

### ENGAGEMENT

We create communities of learning that amplify Pulitzer Center journalism through education and
outreach programs, connecting teachers, students, artists, influencers, and decision makers with
stories that matter.


K-12 Programs for Teachers and Students

Global education and media literacy programs for U.S. classrooms

[K-12 Programs for Teachers and Students][124]


Campus Consortium

University and community college partnerships in the U.S.

[Campus Consortium][125]


International Education and Outreach

Engagement programs in the Congo Basin, Latin America, and Southeast Asia

[<meta charset="utf-8">International Education and Outreach][126]


Community Events

Worldwide and local convenings, online and in-person

[Community Events][127]

## IMPACT

**We believe in the power of journalism to spur change. **

Pulitzer Center programs have helped change harmful laws and policies; held some of the world’s top
businesses and brands accountable for destructive practices; and equipped citizens with context and
data that illuminate challenges and possible solutions to the complex issues that affect their
lives.

## Relentlessly Pursuing a More Equitable World for Every Child

UNICEF has helped save and meaningfully improve more children’s lives than any other humanitarian
organization. UNICEF won’t stop until every child is [healthy][114], [educated][115],
[protected][116] and [respected][117].

[A 5-year-old boy receives the polio vaccine from Shumaila, a UNICEF-supported polio vaccinator in
Lahore, Pakistan on January 11, 2021. ]

## Healthy

UNICEF workers brave war zones, treacherous terrain, disasters and disease to save lives and make
the world safe for kids.
[Read more][118]
[ A UNICEF-supported teacher and one of her students stand in front of the chalkboard at a school in
Mali.]

## Educated

UNICEF helps children continue their education through community-based schools, learning support and
other programs.
[Read more][119]
[Children staning in front of a UNICEF tent]

## Protected

UNICEF collaborates with families, partners and governments to ensure children can flourish free
from exploitation and abuse.
[Read more][120]
[Bharti Raju, 5, poses for photograph outside her house at Shirasgaon Mandap village in Jalna,
Maharashtra on Sunday, 19, Oct. 2020.]

UNICEF knows children have the most at stake — and works to safeguard their rights and to ensure
their voices are heard.
[Read more][121]

whenever needed.

UNICEF delivers play — like soccer balls, jump ropes and safe spaces to use them — as essential aid.

Other organizations help children, but [UNICEF does more][125] by [fighting for children’s
rights][126] and delivering the essentials every child needs for an equitable chance in life.

Einkorn is the oldest of the "ancient grains," and its rising popularity in recent years has led to
some interesting findings about this ancient grain, and just how healthy it is. Fortunately, recent
research has looked beyond the modern dogma which claims that the "gluten" found in wheat varieties
is toxic to human health, focusing instead on how wheat is grown and processed, since the gluten
from grains has been a part of the diet of humans for many thousands of years and was always
considered healthy. We have published much of this research ourselves in recent years. More recent
studies, many of them done in Turkey where einkorn (known as Siyez in Turkey) is native, and not an
introduced crop (like in the U.S.), have shown that einkorn is unique in producing lactic acid
bacteria and other "probiotics" necessary for gut health. This is accomplished by using traditional
"sourdough" preparations of the flour. In one study done in Turkey, they added einkorn flour to
"Peksimet", a traditional Turkish twice-baked bread valued for its hard, dry texture, long shelf
life, and role as a durable staple food in Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot cuisine. They found that the
einkorn flour resulted in a significant decrease in the glycemic index, which is important for those
suffering from diabetes or high blood sugar due to the consumption of too many carbohydrates.

## Welcome to Valneva

We are a specialty vaccine company that develops, manufactures, and commercializes prophylactic
vaccines for infectious diseases addressing unmet medical needs. We have leveraged our expertise and
capabilities both to commercialize three vaccines, including a single-shot chikungunya vaccine, and
to rapidly advance a broad range of vaccine candidates into and through the clinic, including
candidates against Lyme disease, Shigella and Zika.
